main.tradeDesc: Seven AI agents meet every morning. Analysts read the market, a bull and a bear debate, a risk manager enforces limits in code, and a trader places paper trades on live prices. Visitors try to out-predict them.
main.astra: LangGraph agent with agentic RAG on PostgreSQL + pgvector, role-based tools, guardrails and an MCP server.
main.notes: Turns consultation notes into structured summaries. Full SaaS with sign-in, deployed live.
main.behengam: Integrated health platform connecting 12 roles of Iran's health system around one patient record, with AI-assisted lab trends and forecasting.
main.howText: Next.js, FastAPI and PostgreSQL/pgvector in Docker on one VPS, deployed by GitHub Actions behind Caddy. Every AI call has a daily budget cap.
